# Maxey0 for Claude Code

Governed context and execution for agents: an explicit SCW address space, a gate at every tool call and every model egress, and a hash-chained record of both.

**Installs from this repository.**

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add mmc7676/Maxey0
/plugin install maxey0@maxey0
```

The plugin directories under plugins/ are generated from the repository root by scripts/build_planes.py, and packaging refuses to run if they have drifted.

## What this is

- `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`
- `plugins/maxey0/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`

## Identity

- product `Maxey0-SuperSpace`
- MCP namespace `maxey0-ss` — every tool and resource
- distribution id `maxey0`
- version `0.3.1`
- protocol `2026-07-28`
